summary: Hatay stands under the national framework of Türkiye. The source inventory holds no Hatay-specific law, ordinance, enforcement action, detention, facility practice or event ban affecting trans visitors, so the national assessment carries the province.
tangentialFactors: No governor's order, police operation, court ruling or municipal measure in Hatay appears in the inventory. Material in the sources that concerns other parts of Türkiye is carried by the Türkiye record and is not attributed to Hatay here.
localsOnly: Residents of Hatay fall under the same national legal regime as the rest of Türkiye. The inventory records no provincial healthcare provider, shelter, advocacy organisation or support service operating in Hatay, and no statement by a local authority on trans residents.
outOfScopeNotes: Whether the Hatay governor's office has restricted assemblies, whether provincial police carry out identity checks of the kind documented elsewhere in Türkiye, and whether a Hatay court has ruled on an LGBTI+ association or event case are unresolved in the sources. The inventory carries no provincial breakdown of detentions or violations, so national figures cannot be attributed to Hatay.
